children: Moleculin Biotech completed enrollment of 89 subjects in Part A of the pivotal Phase 2/3 MIRACLE trial, keeping a comprehensive Part A data readout on track for Q1 2027.
AnnAraC Part A enrollment closed at 89 subjects with one additional subject in screening, supporting trial momentum.
Company remains on schedule for a comprehensive Part A data readout in Q1 2027, larger than prior interim n45 analysis.
Expanded Part A dataset expected to compare outcomes across prior 1L treatments (7+3 vs venetoclax-based regimens).
Company estimates Part A will end ~50/50 between “fit” (7+3) and “unfit” (venetoclax) subjects, informing efficacy across populations.
Blinded data continue to show an absence of cardiotoxicity for Annamycin, distinguishing it from conventional anthracyclines.

title: Moleculin Biotech completes Part A enrollment in MIRACLE; 89 patients, Q1 2027 readout on track
